scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wasalx/observability run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build
scripts.test:design-system: node --test tests/design-system-governance.test.mjs && pnpm run build:storybook && node --test tests/storybook-static-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:inbox:synthetic: pnpm run build:storybook && node scripts/storybook-visual-regression.mjs --require-browser inbox-synthetic.spec.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:i18n && pnpm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/portal-security-headers.test.mjs
scripts.test:i18n: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/i18n-foundation.test.mjs tests/i18n-key-usage.test.mjs tests/i18n-server-surfaces.test.mjs tests/tenant-shell-i18n.test.mjs tests/automation-cases-i18n.test.mjs tests/workspace-switching.test.mjs
scripts.test:client-routing: pnpm --filter @wasalx/core run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/control-api run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/connector-worker run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/client-routing.test.ts tests/client-routing-control-api.test.mjs tests/routing-sync.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:services && node --test  && node scripts/run-application-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:provider-simulation: pnpm run build:services && node --test    tests/seed-simulation-group.test.mjs tests/owned-work-restoration.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run zammad:package && pnpm run build:services && node scripts/test-unit.mjs
scripts.test:workspace-controller: pnpm --filter @wasalx/tenant-provisioner run build && node --test tests/tenant-workspace-controller.test.mjs tests/tenant-provisioner.test.mjs tests/tenant-provisioner-infra.test.mjs
scripts.test:workspace-provider: pnpm --filter @wasalx/workspace-provider run build && node --test tests/workspace-provider.test.mjs tests/workspace-provider-infra.test.mjs
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm run build:services && node scripts/test-postgres-integration.mjs && node --test tests/postgres-load-recovery.test.mjs
scripts.build:services: pnpm --filter @wasalx/observability run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/core run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/control-api run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/connector-worker run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/tenant-provisioner run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/invitation-mailer run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/identity-policy-activator run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/workspace-provider run build && pnpm --filter @wasalx/workspace-configurator run build
scripts.docker:build: docker compose build portal control-api connector-worker secret-sidecar invitation-mailer identity-policy-activator && docker build --file Dockerfile.tenant-provisioner --tag wasalx/tenant-provisioner:local . && docker build --file Dockerfile.tenant-workspace-controller --tag wasalx/tenant-workspace-controller:local . && docker build --file Dockerfile.workspace-provider --tag wasalx/workspace-provider:local . && docker build --file Dockerfile.workspace-configurator --tag wasalx/workspace-configurator:local .
